metadata.creator: Tim Westwood
metadata.description:
No date on this tape but I'm going with early 1994 (could be late '93 though). Ladbroke Grove's Cash Crew are in the studio plus there's tunes by MOP, Wu Tang, Gang Starr and Big Daddy Kane. Jay The Sultan checks in from NYC for the rap report and drops a sneaky snippet of 'Life's A Bitch' over the phone and there's a some classics by EPMD, Ultimate Force and Eric B & Rakim. Lovely.

- DJ Step One

metadata.hhra_archivenotes: This is dated in February, as the senate hearings on Gangster Rap (which started in February 1994) are mentioned and Hard to Earn (which came out on March 8, 1994) hadn't yet dropped.
